bridge-type.label: Eight Sleep Account
bridge-type.description: An Eight Sleep cloud account. Each account bridge handles one Eight Sleep login and polls the Eight Sleep cloud API for device and sleep data.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: The e-mail address of your Eight Sleep account.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: The password of your Eight Sleep account.

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: Optional OAuth client id override. Leave empty to use the client id of the official mobile app.

parameter.name: clientSecret
parameter.label: Client Secret
parameter.description: Optional OAuth client secret override. Leave empty to use the client secret of the official mobile app.

parameter.name: deviceRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Device Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Polling interval in seconds for device state (heating levels, water, presence).

parameter.name: userRefreshInterval
parameter.label: User Data Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Polling interval in seconds for sleep data (trends, alarms).

parameter.name: baseRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Base Data Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Polling interval in seconds for adjustable base data (angles, presets).

parameter.name: temperatureUnit
parameter.label: Temperature Unit
parameter.description: Unit used to interpret plain number commands for temperatures. Leave empty to use Celsius. Quantity commands always carry their own unit.

thing-type.label: Bed Side
thing-type.description: A single side of an Eight Sleep smart mattress: sleep metrics, temperature control, base control and alarms of one sleeper.

parameter.name: userId
parameter.label: User ID
parameter.description: The Eight Sleep user id of the sleeper on this bed side. Populated automatically by discovery.

parameter.name: label
parameter.label: Side
parameter.description: The physical side this user sleeps on. Choose "Both (solo)" when one user controls the whole mattress; data is read from the left zone, which is the only zone populated for solo beds. Leave empty to default to Left.

channel-group-type.label: Current Sleep
channel-group-type.description: Data of the current or most recent sleep session.

channel-group-type.label: Last Sleep
channel-group-type.description: Summary of the last completed sleep session.

channel-group-type.label: Device State
channel-group-type.description: Live device level data for this side of the mattress cover.

channel-group-type.label: Adjustable Base
channel-group-type.description: Controls and sensors of an optional Eight Sleep adjustable base. Only available when a base is paired with the bed.

channel-group-type.label: Pillow
channel-group-type.description: The Pod 5 pillow, which heats and cools independently of the pod. Only populated when a pillow is reported for this bed side.

channel-type.label: Bed Temperature
channel-type.description: Current temperature measured at the mattress surface of this side.

channel-type.label: Target Temperature
channel-type.description: Target bed temperature. Set it to heat or cool this side. The valid range corresponds to the raw heating level range -100 to 100 of the Eight Sleep API.

channel-type.label: Room Temperature
channel-type.description: Ambient room temperature measured by the mattress cover.

channel-type.label: Heart Rate
channel-type.description: Current heart rate in beats per minute.

channel-type.label: Respiratory Rate
channel-type.description: Current respiratory rate in breaths per minute.

channel-type.label: Heart Rate Variability
channel-type.description: Current heart rate variability.

channel-type.label: Breath Rate
channel-type.description: Breathing rate reported by the sleep tracking.

channel-type.label: Sleep Score
channel-type.description: Overall sleep score as computed by the Eight Sleep cloud.

channel-type.label: Sleep Quality Score
channel-type.description: Sleep quality score as computed by the Eight Sleep cloud.

channel-type.label: Sleep Routine Score
channel-type.description: Sleep routine score as computed by the Eight Sleep cloud.

channel-type.label: Sleep Fitness Score
channel-type.description: Sleep fitness score as computed by the Eight Sleep cloud.

channel-type.label: Time Slept
channel-type.description: Total duration of the last sleep session.

channel-type.label: Light Sleep Duration
channel-type.description: Time spent in light sleep during the last session.

channel-type.label: Deep Sleep Duration
channel-type.description: Time spent in deep sleep during the last session.

channel-type.label: REM Sleep Duration
channel-type.description: Time spent in REM sleep during the last session.

channel-type.label: Awake Duration
channel-type.description: Time spent awake during the last session.

channel-type.label: Sleep Stage
channel-type.description: Current stage of the active sleep session (awake, light, deep, rem).

channel-type.label: Tosses and Turns
channel-type.description: Number of tosses and turns during the last session.

channel-type.label: Session Start
channel-type.description: Date and time when the current sleep session started.

channel-type.label: Session End
channel-type.description: Date and time when the sleep session ended.

channel-type.label: Next Alarm
channel-type.description: Date and time of the next scheduled alarm.

channel-type.label: Alarm Enabled
channel-type.description: Enable or disable the next scheduled alarm.

channel-type.label: Alarm Time
channel-type.description: Time of day of the next scheduled alarm. Command a DateTime to reschedule it.

channel-type.label: Dismiss Alarm
channel-type.description: Trigger to dismiss/stop the currently ringing or next alarm.

channel-type.label: Snooze Alarm
channel-type.description: Trigger to snooze the currently ringing alarm for the configured snooze minutes.

channel-type.label: Heating Level
channel-type.description: Raw heating/cooling level as used by the Eight Sleep API (-100 to 100).

channel-type.label: Heating State
channel-type.description: Whether this side is currently heating, cooling or idle.

channel-type.label: Heating Time Remaining
channel-type.description: Remaining time of the current heating/cooling period.

channel-type.label: Side Power
channel-type.description: Turn this side of the bed on (smart mode) or off.

channel-type.label: Base Preset
channel-type.description: Preset position of the adjustable base.

channel-type.label: Head Angle
channel-type.description: Angle of the head/torso section of the adjustable base (0-45 degrees).

channel-type.label: Feet Angle
channel-type.description: Angle of the feet/leg section of the adjustable base (0-20 degrees).

channel-type.label: Snore Mitigation
channel-type.description: ON while snore mitigation is actively raising the head section.

channel-type.label: Bed Presence
channel-type.description: ON when someone is present on this side of the bed.

channel-type.label: LED Brightness
channel-type.description: Brightness of the hub LED (0-100).

channel-type.label: Has Water
channel-type.description: ON when the water reservoir has water. OFF means you need to refill.

channel-type.label: Needs Priming
channel-type.description: ON when the device reports it needs priming.

channel-type.label: Priming In Progress
channel-type.description: ON while a priming run is in progress.

channel-type.label: Last Prime
channel-type.description: Date and time of the last completed priming.

channel-type.label: Away Mode
channel-type.description: ON while this user is in away mode. Turn it on/off to start or end away mode. The state is UNDEF until the first away-status poll, then reflects what the API reports, so it also flips when away mode is changed in the Eight Sleep app.

channel-type.label: Start Priming
channel-type.description: Send ON to start the pod priming procedure. This user receives the completion notification. Check isPriming for progress.
